== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|An [[Awakened]] blade is a tool or weapon that has undergone a mysterious and poorly understood transformation known as [[Awakening]]. This process involves the blending of [[Intent]] from three distinct sources: the object itself, its owner, and [[the Reader]] performing the [[Awakening]]. During this transition, an object's physical form changes once to align with its [[invested Intent]]; however, it cannot be reshaped after this initial change. Once [[Awakened]], an object gains a rudimentary consciousness related to its purpose and can utilize its stored [[Intent]] to achieve goals, though it can no longer accumulate new [[Intent]]. While anyone is capable of using an [[Awakened weapon]], only a [[Soulbound]] can wield its power without restriction. These weapons vary significantly in appearance and capability. Some, such as those with orange-spotted patterns, possess corrosive properties that can dissolve lesser [[Elderspawn]] into sludge. Others may carry heavy emotional residues, such as the resentment of dead men or a desperate yearning for salvation, which can distort the senses of those nearby. Certain [[Awakened objects]] are exceptionally powerful, capable of blighting forests or acting as a bridge between human and imperial powers. In extreme cases, an object may be on the verge of [[Awakening]] itself, or it may be a [[Soulbound]] vessel tied to its captain. While highly effective against many foes, the efficacy of an [[Awakened]] blade depends on the rank of the target, as they may struggle against higher-level entities.}}
